+/** A static label avoids repeating outlined-label/notch layout during command review. */
+@Composable private fun CommandEditor(activity:MainActivity) {
+    BasicTextField(
+        value=activity.transcript,
+        onValueChange={activity.transcript=it},
+        minLines=3,
+        textStyle=MaterialTheme.typography.bodyLarge.copy(color=MaterialTheme.colorScheme.onSurface),

+            }
+        }
+    )
